definitionUrl.description: Absolute URL of this definition's OpenAPI document.

documentationUrl.description: Absolute URL of the human-readable reference.

operations.description: Every operation the definition serves, each with its method, path, permission, filters, paging, fields, and whether this credential may call it. A route that serves a retired entity's row in place of a live one names that row's fields in retiredFields, which is null on every other route. Embedded rather than served separately: an operation has no identity apart from the definition it belongs to.

preferred.description: True for the version a new integration should build against.

controlId.description: The framework's control, not a TrustOnCloud control identifier.

requestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.

Page.description: The collection envelope. A route with a declared projection narrows `items` to its own row schema.

nextCursor.description: Absent as null on the last page. No total count is served.

ThreatmodelsProviderServiceActionsRow.description: A live entity's row, or a retired entity's row in its place. `retired` tells them apart.

oneOf.description: A retired entity keeps its place in the ordering and carries only these properties. It has no feature class, so it appears only on an unfiltered page.

ThreatmodelsProviderServiceControlsRow.description: A live entity's row, or a retired entity's row in its place. `retired` tells them apart.

assured_by.description: A comma-separated string, published as it is rather than split into an array.

depends_on.description: A comma-separated string, published as it is rather than split into an array.

effort.description: One of Very High, High, Medium, Low.

feature_class.description: An array of feature classes. A threat's field of the same name is a single string.

mitigate.description: Objects carrying threat, impact, priority, max_dependency, priority_overall and cvss, where cvss is a severity enum from Very High to Very Low.

weighted_priority.description: One of Very High, High, Medium, Low.

oneOf.description: A retired entity keeps its place in the ordering and carries only these properties. It has no feature class, so it appears only on an unfiltered page.

ThreatmodelsProviderServiceThreatsRow.description: A live entity's row, or a retired entity's row in its place. `retired` tells them apart.

access.description: A nested boolean expression over permissions, with the keys AND, OR, OPTIONAL and UNIQUE. Not an access level.

cvss.description: A CVSS vector string. A control's mitigate[].cvss is a severity enum instead.

feature_class.description: A single feature class. A control's field of the same name is an array.

mitre_attack.description: One MITRE ATT&CK tactic id, such as TA0040. Not a list of mappings.

oneOf.description: A retired entity keeps its place in the ordering and carries only these properties. It has no feature class, so it appears only on an unfiltered page.

apiKey.description: A tenant API key, in `Authorization: Bearer`. Never a query parameter: that writes the credential into access logs.

info.description: Read access to the ThreatModel data your tenant is entitled to. Every route is read-only, authenticated with a tenant API key, and additionally restricted to your tenant's allowed IP ranges.
